data.narrative:
Living Carbon is a Series A-stage biotech company founded by Maddie Hall and Patrick Mellor, having raised $36M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector, including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable valuation method here. Using total raised ($36M) as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement to subsequent stages yields an implied valuation of $72M. Peer-median triangulation is not feasible: while 7 same-sector peers exist, fewer than 3 meet narrow filters for stage, adjacency, or valuation tier. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (median 6.6x across the three public tickers) cannot be applied without the target's revenue, which is not disclosed.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $61M (low) to $83M (high), centered at $72M. This range reflects typical step-up mechanics at the Series A stage. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrower peer comparables at identical stage and size, lack of revenue data precluding multiple-based anchoring, and reliance on a single applicable method. Investors should weight this estimate accordingly and seek additional operational milestones or revenue traction to refine the range.
